name: number-field
description: Numeric input with stepper buttons, min/max/step, keyboard control and Intl number formatting

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import {
  NumberFieldRoot,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
  type NumberFieldRootEmits,
  type NumberFieldRootProps,
} from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

// Thin styled wrapper over Reka's NumberFieldRoot. useForwardPropsEmits only
// forwards props the consumer actually set, so Reka's own defaults
// (stepSnapping, focusOnChange = true) survive Vue's boolean-prop casting.
// Note Reka's prop is `readonly` (lowercase), unlike React's `readOnly`.
const props = defineProps<NumberFieldRootProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>()
const emits = defineEmits<NumberFieldRootEmits>()

const delegatedProps = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <NumberFieldRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    data-slot="number-field"
    :class="cn('grid gap-1.5', props.class)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </NumberFieldRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { NumberFieldInput as NumberFieldInputPrimitive, useForwardProps, type NumberFieldInputProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

// Reka renders <input type="text" role="spinbutton"> with aria-valuenow/min/max,
// inputmode, and ArrowUp/Down, PageUp/Down (×10), Home/End handling; the id set
// on <NumberField> lands here so a <Label for> can target it.
const props = defineProps<NumberFieldInputProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>()

const delegatedProps = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})

const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <NumberFieldInputPrimitive
    v-bind="forwarded"
    data-slot="number-field-input"
    :class="
      cn(
        'w-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-3 text-center text-base font-bold tabular-nums placeholder:font-normal placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed md:text-sm',
        props.class
      )
    "
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { NumberFieldIncrement as NumberFieldIncrementPrimitive, useForwardProps, type NumberFieldIncrementProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { Plus } from '@lucide/vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

// Reka sets tabindex="-1", the "Increase" aria-label, press-and-hold
// repeat, and disables the button at the bound.
const props = defineProps<NumberFieldIncrementProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>()

const delegatedProps = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})

const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <NumberFieldIncrementPrimitive
    v-bind="forwarded"
    data-slot="number-field-increment"
    :class="
      cn(
        'flex w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center border-foreground bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground transition-[background-color,box-shadow] duration-100 hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground active:shadow-[inset_3px_3px_0px_hsl(var(--shadow-color))] data-[pressed]:shadow-[inset_3px_3px_0px_hsl(var(--shadow-color))] focus-visible:outline-none disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:stroke-[3]',
        'border-l-3',
        props.class
      )
    "
  >
    <slot>
      <Plus aria-hidden="true" />
    </slot>
  </NumberFieldIncrementPrimitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { NumberFieldDecrement as NumberFieldDecrementPrimitive, useForwardProps, type NumberFieldDecrementProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { Minus } from '@lucide/vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

// Reka sets tabindex="-1", the "Decrease" aria-label, press-and-hold
// repeat, and disables the button at the bound.
const props = defineProps<NumberFieldDecrementProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>()

const delegatedProps = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})

const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <NumberFieldDecrementPrimitive
    v-bind="forwarded"
    data-slot="number-field-decrement"
    :class="
      cn(
        'flex w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center border-foreground bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground transition-[background-color,box-shadow] duration-100 hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground active:shadow-[inset_3px_3px_0px_hsl(var(--shadow-color))] data-[pressed]:shadow-[inset_3px_3px_0px_hsl(var(--shadow-color))] focus-visible:outline-none disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:stroke-[3]',
        'border-r-3',
        props.class
      )
    "
  >
    <slot>
      <Minus aria-hidden="true" />
    </slot>
  </NumberFieldDecrementPrimitive>
</template>
